name: Hilton Honors Credit Cards

apr.notes: Variable APR based on creditworthiness and the Prime Rate. Cash advance APR 28.74%. Penalty APR 29.99%. Accurate as of 07/23/26.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; Amex generally requires good to excellent credit.

categories.label: U.S. restaurants, including takeout and delivery

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemable for reward nights, car rentals, shopping, and exclusive experiences through Hilton Honors.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 Hilton Honors Bonus Points and a $100 Statement Credit after spending $2,000 in first 6 months.

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Silver Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Silver status. 20% Bonus on Base Points per stay, fifth night free on standard room stays with points. Spend $20,000 in a calendar year to upgrade to Gold Status through end of next calendar year.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees from American Express when using the Card abroad.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of rental vehicle when reserving and paying with the Card and declining CDW. Not available in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance when traveling more than 100 miles from home, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wires, and missing luggage assistance.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against accidental damage or theft for up to 90 days. Up to $1,000 per purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Hilton Honors Silver Status (complimentary); upgrade to Gold after $20,000 spend in a calendar year
other: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance

notes: Product name is not a Network Tier; network_tier is none for Amex network packages. Annual fee is $0 (no annual fee). Signup bonus and benefits verified on official Amex product page.
